# thoth_governance_executive_summary (Data Source)

Reads board-ready executive summary metrics for governance posture and cost signals.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `days` (Number) Optional lookback window in days.
- `rate` (Number) Optional custom pricing rate in USD per 1K tokens.

### Read-Only

- `mcp_critical_deviation_alerts` (Number) Critical MCP deviation alerts in the executive summary window.
- `mcp_deviation_alerts` (Number) Total MCP deviation alerts in the executive summary window.
- `response_json` (String) Executive summary payload as JSON.
